memories.author: D05
memories.text: Generalised anxiety disorder and psoriasis. Patient reports excessive worry, restlessness, mild insomnia; plaques on elbows and knees with silvery scales. PHQ-9 5, GAD-7 12. Examination: anxious affect, no tachycardia, skin lesions as described. Started escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topically, calcipotriol ointment OD topically, methotrexate 7.5 mg once weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:

Buspirone 5 mg tablet BD
Clobetasol 0.05% cream 30 g BD topically
Calcipotriol ointment 30 g OD topically
Methotrexate 2.5 mg tablet (3 tablets) once weekly
Folic acid 5 mg tablet OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Review of labs: LFT normal, Hb stable. Psoriasis plaques reduced ~40%, itching less. Anxiety improved, GAD-7 now 8. Continue current meds. Methotrexate well tolerated, no dose change. Advise sunscreen, moisturiser.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-08-05 at 10:30 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Patient reports good control of anxiety, GAD-7 6. Psoriasis: plaques mild, some residual scaling on knees. No side effects. Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, topical steroids as needed, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg OD.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling more worried about work deadlines, trouble falling asleep, waking early. Skin okay.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Anxiety improved further, GAD-7 4, reports better sleep. Psoriasis: minimal plaques, mild erythema only. No new side effects. Continue current regimen. Plan to taper topical steroid if clearance maintained.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X-ray PA: lungs clear, no infiltrate, cardiac silhouette normal. No pleural effusion. (Baseline study performed due to occupational exposure concerns.)

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Review after chest X-ray. Anxiety stable GAD-7 5. Psoriasis: clear skin, occasional mild dryness. No methotrexate toxicity. Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, buspirone 10 mg BD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg OD. Advise continue moisturiser, use topical steroid only for flare.
